writeup.headline: S&P +0.5% at Lunch; Technology Leads
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Chip Stocks Split: Memory Names Rally, Apple Still Drags. The AI names are up and the average stock is flat: the AI giants are leading while the rest of the market lags. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.
